issues.proposed_action: Use the single proposed base/gold/caller-level alternative matrix with unchanged reference tests; independently review results before changing any task specification.

issues.scope: Gold removes optional status text and retains diff not supported for missing-old numeric display. The prompt constrains the channel of emitted messages but does not unambiguously require a nonempty no-change status. Silence may satisfy it; missing stderr alone does not establish an incorrect gold. Numeric example and caller-level oracle concerns remain static.
issues.proposed_action: Compare gold against public CLI examples and keep original benchmark untouched; any narrowed prompt or revised oracle must be a separate reviewed revision.

issues.scope: Five formatter P2Ps and one mocked argument-forwarding P2P were fully read. Missing-old string P2P retains old wording; numeric example is untested. Functional diff tests are public but not selected in the observed run.
issues.proposed_action: Preserve justified old behavior, distinguish formatter compatibility from public CLI output, and include targeted functional cases in the same diagnostic matrix.
